teennick.us.description: When a sinkhole opens up at school, Lincoln and his classmates are forced to share lockers; when Lana brings home a skunk to rehabilitate, Lola grows attached when she finds the skunk has finer tastes.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Crying Dame; Anti Social
teennick.us.description: The children give Lily an old singing toy from the attic to help her stop crying, but it quickly drives them crazy; the kids try to convince Dad of the wonders of modern technology after he declares war on their electronic devices.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Stage Plight; Antiqued Off
teennick.us.description: Luan tries out for the school play to get closer to her crush, Benny; when Clyde and schoolmate Zach begin bonding over a mutual interest in antiques, Lincoln quickly finds himself feeling like a third wheel.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Baby Steps; Brawl in the Family
teennick.us.description: When Clyde thinks that his parents are having another baby, he seeks Lincoln's advice on how to be a big brother; a fight breaks out in the Loud house when Lori and Leni buy identical dresses.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Really Loud Music
teennick.us.description: Hoping to win a songwriting contest, Luna contemplates whether she should go with a song that's true to her sound or try to make something that the whole world will love.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Appetite for Destruction; Frame on You
teennick.us.description: When Lily starts misbehaving at home, Mom and Dad think her new preschool friends might be the cause; when Rusty is wrongfully suspended, the Action News Team leaps into action to clear his name.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Sound of Silence; Space Invader
teennick.us.description: Lincoln uses sound-canceling ear buds to try and drown out his sisters; after Lynn and Lucy get in a fight, Lincoln agrees to let Lynn bunk in his room for one night.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Summer Camp: The Grate Outdoors; Summer Camp: Don't Lose Your Cool
teennick.us.description: At Camp Mastodon, Lynn pushes an overly-cautious Lisa to become more adventurous; when Lori learns her Camp Mastodon campers think she's uncool, she tries to impress them by breaking the rules.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - A Bug's Strife; All the Rage
teennick.us.description: Dad tears the house apart trying to find the cricket ruining his peaceful day alone in the house; tired of getting pummeled during dodgeball, Lincoln and the gang use Clyde's untapped rage without him knowing.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Lock 'N Loud; The Whole Picture
teennick.us.description: When Dad gets upset with the children for never locking the front door, they decide to take home security to the next level; when Lincoln accidentally erases his childhood photos, he and Clyde attempt to recreate them before his memory fades.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Gown and Out; Breaking Dad
teennick.us.description: When Lola advances to a regional pageant she worries she could lose for the first time; Dad has Mr. Grouse watch Lily while he goes to a concert, but things quickly start to go wrong.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Car Trek
teennick.us.description: Charlotte's birthday road trip to see the Boo Man Group perform gets sidetracked by a Captain Man and Kid Danger emergency.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Mr. Nice Guy
teennick.us.description: A vigilante in a smiley-face mask punishes Swellviewians for being rude in public; Kid Danger and Captain Man's investigation leads them to the TV set of Mr. Wallabee, a local TV celebrity who hosts a show for children.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Henry's Jelly
teennick.us.description: After Jasper is lauded for being a local hero, Henry becomes jealous that Kid Danger is the one getting all the thanks.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Text, Lies & Video
teennick.us.description: When a video of Henry and Ray transforming into Kid Danger and Captain Man gets out, Henry must go to great lengths to retrieve it and protect his secret identity.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Whistlin' Susie
teennick.us.description: After activating an atomic bomb in the Man Cave, Ray and Henry decide to drive it out into the Swellview desert in order to save their city.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Meet Cute Crush
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray try to help Piper get to know a new boy she likes from school.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Cave the Date
teennick.us.description: Henry and the gang set up a secret underground restaurant in the Man Cave for Charlotte's private dinner with music superstar Jack Swagger; when word gets out that Jack Swagger is in town, some unwanted guests crash the party.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Drex
teennick.us.description: Captain Man's old sidekick and nemesis, Drex, returns from the past with an army of cavemen to finish off Captain Man once and for all; Kid Danger may be the only one who can save Captain Man.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Diamonds Are for Heather
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man are called to the Swellview Museum of Stools and Jewels to prevent the rare Neal Diamond from being stolen.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Up the Stairs!
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray's friendship is put to the ultimate test when they have to endure the half-mile trek up the Man Cave stairs in order to make a surprise meal by a celebrity chef in Junk-N-Stuff.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Tears of the Jolly Beetle
teennick.us.description: When Captain Man loses his powers of invulnerability and becomes too afraid to fight crime, Kid Danger must keep Swellview safe.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Elevator Kiss
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger rescues Bianca, and they share a kiss; Henry is upset when he realizes that Bianca kissed Kid Danger.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Toon in for Danger
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray get a copy of the new Kid Danger and Captain Man cartoon and see that it's horrible; they must hurry to fix the cartoon before the big premiere party.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - EnvyGram Wall
teennick.us.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger guard Swellview's newest attraction, the EnvyGram Wall; when Captain Man destroys the wall while trying to eliminate a small bird, Kid Danger and Captain Man have to figure out a way to replace it.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - I Know Your Secret
teennick.us.description: When Henry receives a series of mysterious notes from someone, he begins to worry that the sender may know his secret identity.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Green Fingers
teennick.us.description: After Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally affects Charlotte, Henry, his family, and even Ray, he quarantines them in Henry's house in order to find a cure.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - A Tale of Two Pipers
teennick.us.description: Henry gets an unexpected visitor claiming to be from the future; when a boy-robot killing machine steps onto the scene, the gang must find a way to save everyone from an apocalyptic future.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Love Muffin
teennick.us.description: Henry and Charlotte discover things are not what they seem when Captain Man suddenly announces his plans to marry.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - A Fiñata Full of Death Bugs
teennick.us.description: When a dangerous piñata winds up at a child's birthday party, Kid Danger and Captain Man must go undercover to step in before it is too late.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Beat Goes On
teennick.us.description: Henry finds himself in danger when he realizes Dr. Minyak has transformed Charlotte into a super strong being set to capture Kid Danger and Captain Man.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Whole Bilsky Family
teennick.us.description: Henry's nerves are tested when Piper invites her new boyfriend and his family over for dinner.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Henry's Frittle Problem
teennick.us.description: When Henry's dad gets an offer for a new job in Bordertown, Henry and Ray go undercover to try and stop him from getting the job and prevent Henry from having to move.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Massage Chair
teennick.us.description: When Captain Man shows up with a cool new massage chair, Henry, Charlotte and Jasper compete in a series of physical and mental challenges to see who wins the chair.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Henry's Birthday
teennick.us.description: While trying to celebrate his birthday, Henry keeps getting interrupted by crimes going on in Swellview.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Balloons of Doom
teennick.us.description: When Dr. Minyak takes the Man Fans hostage, Captain Man and Kid Danger have to find a way to rescue them without Dr. Minyak seeing them move.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Double Date Danger
teennick.us.description: When Miss Shapen's niece comes into town and chooses Jasper over Henry, he discovers that she has much bigger plans in the works.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Trouble With Frittles
teennick.us.description: Captain Man and Kid Danger find themselves in the middle of a debate about Swellview's favorite snack.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Mom
teennick.us.description: When labor pains leave Captain Man helpless, Kid Danger and Piper step up to take on a couple of slick grease thieves.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Stuck in Two Holes
teennick.us.description: Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Secret Room
teennick.us.description: Captain Man reveals a Crime fighters Only room in the Man Cave; when Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up, the gang fights over who gets the better room and things get blown out of proportion.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Super Volcano
teennick.us.description: Henry and Ray think the world is ending when a dormant super volcano under Swellview becomes active; Piper is convinced that she has gluten intolerance.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Escape Room
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man enter an escape room by a factory owner with a "chip" on his shoulder, and become trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles they need to answer to get out.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Beginning of the End
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger reveals to Captain Man that he doesn't want to be stuck in Swellview and be his sidekick forever; to make matters worse, Kid Danger is recruited by another town to be their hero.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Invisible Brad
teennick.us.description: Captain Man's friend, who was accidentally turned invisible, shows up for a visit, but quickly overstays his welcome.

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Twin Henrys
teennick.us.description: Henry has a shape-shifting android fill in at a family dinner so that he can watch an MMA fight with Charlotte and Ray. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-05-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Game of Phones
teennick.us.description: When a young girl chains herself outside Junk-N-Stuff, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to help find her beloved phone; while on a stakeout, they unexpectedly run across some familiar faces with a devious plan. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-15

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Toddler Invasion
teennick.us.description: When the Toddler takes control of the Man Cave, Charlotte and Jasper have to find a way to sneak in and free Kid Danger and Captain Man. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-05

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Budget Cuts
teennick.us.description: When the Vice Mayor cuts Captain Man and Kid Danger's budget to build a high-speed railway in Swellview, the duo must figure out creative ways to save money. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-04-07

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Flabber Gassed
teennick.us.description: After acting too confident before a fight, Kid Danger and Captain Man are sprayed with Flabber Gas making them powerless to defeat a new villain in Swellview; Schwoz puts the heroes in Exo-Suits which Charlotte and Jasper control. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-10-20

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Rubber Duck
teennick.us.description: When Ray accidentally destroys Henry's dad's prized remote control car, they throw a manicure/pedicure party to raise money to fix it. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-10-13

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Captain Man-kini
teennick.us.description: When a new internet celebrity causes havoc in Swellview, Captain Man has to swap bodies with Frankini to infiltrate his secret lair. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-12

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Double-O Danger
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man attempt to capture mob boss Rob Moss by infiltrating his daughter's Sweet 16 birthday party. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-06-29

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Dream Busters
teennick.us.description: A villain's dream beam traps Henry in a dream state from which only Charlotte can rescue him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-21

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Dodging Danger
teennick.us.description: After Henry uses his new power to compete in a Dodge-A-Leen tournament, Ray, Schwoz and Charlotte go undercover to teach Henry a lesson. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-12-03

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Story Tank
teennick.us.description: Big steaks are on the line when Henry claims he can't be scared; Schwoz uses a machine that allows Henry to virtually experience the spooky stories that everyone in the Man Cave tells him in an attempt to prove Henry wrong. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-10-12

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - My Phony Valentine
teennick.us.description: When Henry's crush goes on a date with someone else, Schwoz provides an android to make her jealous; Ray has an unpleasant date with one of Henry's teachers. (Children, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2015-02-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Man of the House
teennick.us.description: After Henry's mother's purse is stolen, Captain Man decides he must move in with Henry's family in order to protect them. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-14

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Beginning of the End
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger reveals to Captain Man that he doesn't want to be stuck in Swellview and be his sidekick forever; to make matters worse, Kid Danger is recruited by another town to be their hero. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-29

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Escape Room
teennick.us.description: Kid Danger and Captain Man enter an escape room by a factory owner with a "chip" on his shoulder, and become trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles they need to answer to get out. (Children, Sitcom) - 2020-02-08

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Caved In
teennick.us.description: Henry, Charlotte and Ray are trapped inside when Jasper accidentally triggers the emergency lockdown mode for Junk-N-Stuff and the Man Cave. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-02-28

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - My Dinner With Bigfoot
teennick.us.description: When the gang befriends Bigfoot in the woods, Kid Danger and Captain Man try to help get rid of a pesky hunter that's been trying to capture him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-03-09

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Brawl in the Hall
teennick.us.description: When Charlotte is challenged to a fight at school, Captain Man and Kid Danger step in to try and help Charlotte defend herself. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-11-04

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - Grand Theft Otto
teennick.us.description: When Piper's school parrot, Otto, starts to repeat that Henry is Kid Danger, Henry and Jasper have to stall until Ray, Charlotte and Schwoz can find a way to fix things. (Children, Sitcom) - 2019-02-16

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - License to Fly
teennick.us.description: Ray agrees to let Henry fly his helicopter, but Ray starts to act like a nervous parent; Charlotte, Jasper and Piper find a cotton candy machine. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-04-15

teennick.us.title: Henry Danger - The Great Cactus Con
teennick.us.description: Jasper gets the chance to take his crush to Cactus Con, but when a mysterious villain gets involved in the convention, the entire gang is forced into action. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-11-24

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Flip This Flip; Haunted House Call
teennick.us.description: The Loud kids help Flip clean up his image to impress his middle school crush; when the Mortician's Club can't afford tickets to Casket Con, they decide to start a business to raise money. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-03-18

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Grub Snub; She's All Bat
teennick.us.description: When Leni and her friends start hanging out at Gus', Lincoln and the gang start a turf war for control; Lucy gets jealous of Lola's newfound attention after she joins the Mortician's Club. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2021-05-28

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - House of Lies; Game Boys
teennick.us.description: After witnessing an excess of lying in the family, Lisa invents lie-detecting glasses to try and curb the fibs; Lincoln asks to borrow Clyde's new gaming system, but Clyde struggles to trust that it's safe with him. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2018-09-17

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Funny Business; Snow Bored
teennick.us.description: Lincoln begins to hog the spotlight when he becomes Luan's clown assistant; the Loud children have fun on a snow day. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-11-08

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Toads and Tiaras; Two Boys and a Baby
teennick.us.description: When Lola gets sick and is unable to compete in a pageant, Lincoln coaches Lana to take her place; thinking it will be easy, Lincoln and Clyde decide to take on the task of baby-sitting Lily. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-07-21

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Store Wars With the Casagrandes; Lucha Fever With the Casagrandes
teennick.us.description: When a fancy grocery store opens on the block, Bobby rallies the family to do everything they can to compete; Ronnie Anne fakes being sick to watch a Lucha Libre match, which proves to be more difficult than anticipated. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-06-20

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Bummer Camp; Sleepstakes
teennick.us.description: When Gramps struggles to run Camp Mastodon, the kids come to his rescue; the Loud kids help Lana get over her fear of sleepovers. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-06-10

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Cover Girls; Save the Date
teennick.us.description: Lincoln has his hands full when all 10 of his sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day; Bobby and Lori go on a double date with Lincoln and Bobby's little sister, Ronnie Anne. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-08-04

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Left in the Dark; Get the Message
teennick.us.description: Lincoln must beat each of his sisters to the couch in order to watch the finale of his favorite show; Lincoln leaves a scathing voicemail on Lori's phone, and quickly realizes that he must erase it before she hears it. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-02

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Along Came a Sister; Chore and Peace
teennick.us.description: Lincoln must care for the class tarantula; Lincoln decides to go on strike until someone will swap chores. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-04

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Driving Miss Hazy; No Guts, No Glori
teennick.us.description: Finally tired of doing favors for Lori to get rides, Lincoln decides to help Leni pass her driver's test; Lincoln and nine of his sisters work as a team to thwart the tyranny they face with Lori as their babysitter. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-05-10

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Back to School
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max return to their elementary school to complete a hero assessment exam and discover that the instructor is a former classmate that Max tormented. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-08-13

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Max's Minions
teennick.us.description: Max takes on a group of freshmen to be his minions; Max becomes the victim of a humiliating prank. (Children, Sitcom, Action) - 2014-09-27

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - You've Got Fail
teennick.us.description: Max tries to win an epic-fail video contest by submitting a video of Phoebe as she practices ballet, but Phoebe refuses to cooperate. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-02-25

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Gimme a Break-Up
teennick.us.description: Phoebe's relationship with her superhero boyfriend is put to the test when he is offered an assignment overseas. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-11-04

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Come What Mayhem
teennick.us.description: Phoebe makes a life-altering decision when her powers combined with Max's powers are not enough to stop one of Max's old pranks from ruining a superhero gathering. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-06-17

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - May Z-Force Be With You
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe ask Cherry to secretly fill-in after Phoebe injures herself the night before a meeting with the Z-Force. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-03-04

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - No Country for Old Mentors
teennick.us.description: Despite hoping to be matched with her favorite hero in the Superhero Mentor Program, Phoebe feels pressure to choose her father instead. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-11-11

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Not So Fast and Furious
teennick.us.description: A new super-fast villain is wreaking havoc in Secret Shores; after Billy's speed accidentally triggers an avalanche, he decides to hang up his cape and retire. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-02-12

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Save the Date
teennick.us.description: Max bets Phoebe she can't turn off being a superhero and go on a normal date; Chloe helps Phoebe do well on the date, but Max tries to sabotage by crying wolf; suddenly, a real supervillain emerges and puts Max and Chloe in serious danger. (Children, Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2025-02-12

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Rhythm n' Shoes
teennick.us.description: Determined to meet a famous pop singer visiting Hiddenville High, Phoebe and Max devise elaborate schemes to insert themselves into her performance that quickly lead to disastrous results. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-02-17

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Patch Me If You Can
teennick.us.description: While Phoebe is baby-sitting her boyfriend's brother, the boy discovers his evil side after getting his hands on one of Max's inventions. (Children, Holiday, Sitcom) - 2015-10-28

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - I'm Gonna Forget You, Sucka
teennick.us.description: After Cherry accidentally posts a photo revealing the Thundermans' secret, the Hero League forces Phoebe to end the relationship with her best friend. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-07-09

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Smells Like Team Spirit
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max must work together on a series of superhero team-building exercises, but their different approaches to training jeopardizes their future as a crime fighting duo. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-01-07

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Parents Just Don't Thunderstand
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max use one of his devices to make Hank and Barb act like teenagers, but the siblings quickly grow to regret their actions. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2015-01-24

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Robin Hood: Prince of Pheebs
teennick.us.description: When Chloe announces that Max is her favorite sibling, Phoebe tries to reveal Max's true colors using a bedtime story. (Children, Sitcom, Action) - 2016-07-30

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Chutes and Splatters
teennick.us.description: Phoebe must baby-sit President Kuckbutt's troublemaking teen daughter as her latest superhero mission, but the assignment quickly gets out of control. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-06-25

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Aunt Misbehavin'
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe surprise their mother by tracking down her long-lost sister, only to find the sisters have been feuding for years. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-08-06

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Phoebe vs. Max: The Sequel
teennick.us.description: Phoebe's first assignment as a superhero is to protect Hiddenville; Phoebe challenges Max to inject some mischief into their sleepy hometown. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-06-27

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Call of Lunch Duty
teennick.us.description: Phoebe discovers that Max is the person behind the latest rebellious pranks at school, and refuses to reveal his secret to the principal. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-03-10

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Weekend Guest
teennick.us.description: Phoebe volunteers to take home the class's Venus flytrap for the weekend; Max performs an experiment on a plant, causing it to grow continuously. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2013-12-07

themoviechannel.us.title: Patriot Games
themoviechannel.us.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: The Mechanic
themoviechannel.us.description: One of an elite group of assassins, Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) may be the best in the business. Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: The November Man
themoviechannel.us.description: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey). - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Paycheck

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen). - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
themoviechannel.us.description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child. - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Along Came a Spider
themoviechannel.us.description: A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school. - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
themoviechannel.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Basic Instinct
themoviechannel.us.description: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect. (Thriller) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Love and Monsters
themoviechannel.us.description: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 2020

themoviechannel.us.title: Urban Cowboy
themoviechannel.us.description: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition. (Drama) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
themoviechannel.us.description: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve. (Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Flypaper
themoviechannel.us.description: A man tries to protect a teller, whom he secretly loves, after two groups rob her bank at the same time. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: View From the Top
themoviechannel.us.description: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for. (Comedy, Romance, Drama) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
themoviechannel.us.description: When Coast Guard Adm. Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship. (Children, Comedy) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. (Comedy) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Kingpin
themoviechannel.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: The Brothers Grimm
themoviechannel.us.description: The Brothers Grimm, Wilhelm and Jacob, are dysfunctional schemers who go from town to town putting on shows that convince inhabitants they are getting rid of demons. After one such scam, a mysterious man called Cavaldi brings them to a French general, who persuades them to battle the evil that has kidnapped 10 girls from a small village. During the investigation, the cynical Wilhelm and sensitive Jacob see things that point to real magic at work. (Fantasy, Adventure, Mystery, Thriller) - 2005

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Last of Sheila
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Hollywood producer (James Coburn) shares his Riviera yacht with six people who might have killed his wife. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Born Free
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At a national park in Kenya, English game warden George Adamson (Bill Travers) and his wife, Joy (Virginia McKenna), care for three orphaned lion cubs. After the two larger lions are shipped off to a zoo in the Netherlands, the smallest of the three, Elsa, stays with the couple. When Elsa is blamed for causing an elephant stampede in the nearby village, head warden John Kendall (Geoffrey Keen) demands the young lion either be trained to survive in the wilds of the Serengeti or be sent to a zoo. (Docudrama) - 1966

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: A Hard Day's Night
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: John, Paul, George and Ringo (The Beatles) spend 36 wild hours in London, besieged by exuberant fans. - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Breakdown
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A boxer (William Bishop) jailed for murder proves his girlfriend's (Ann Richards) wealthy father and a ward boss framed him. - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cabaret
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Multiple Oscars went to this tale about an American chanteuse in Berlin caught in the rising tide of Nazism. - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lola
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A cabaret singer (Barbara Sukowa) corrupts a stuffy city planner (Armin Mueller-Stahl) in 1957 Germany. - 1982

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wheeler Dealers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Texas oil rascal (James Garner) woos a Wall Street stock analyst (Lee Remick) and takes the market for a ride. - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The High Cost of Loving
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Just as a corporate executive (Jose Ferrer) fears losing his job, his wife (Gena Rowlands) thinks she's finally pregnant. - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Breakdown
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A boxer (William Bishop) jailed for murder proves his girlfriend's (Ann Richards) wealthy father and a ward boss framed him. - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Casablanca
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A cynical nightclub owner in Casablanca protects an old flame and her husband from Nazis, while also trying to navigate his complicated past. - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bad and the Beautiful
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A ruthless producer (Kirk Douglas) uses and discards Hollywood hopefuls as stepping stones to the top of the Tinseltown heap. - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: It Started With a Kiss
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An Air Force sergeant (Glenn Ford) and his bride (Debbie Reynolds) try abstinence and tour Spain in a Lincoln Futura won in a raffle. - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Kiss Me Kate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Lilli and Fred act the same way offstage as they do in The Taming of the Shrew. - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gone to Earth
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Folklore and desire stir an 1890s girl (Jennifer Jones) who lives with her father in English fox-hunting country. - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Duel in the Sun
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tragedy seems to follow Pearl Chavez everywhere she goes. After a domestic dispute results in the death of both of her parents, Pearl moves in with her aunt, Laura Belle, on an expansive farm. When Pearl notices Laura Belle's son, the fiery Lewt, life on the ranch erupts into chaos. The two have a brief courtship, but Lewt abruptly ends the relationship. When Pearl tries to move on, Lewt's jealousy leads to a climactic gun battle between the former lovers. (Western) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wizard of Oz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Young Dorothy (Dorothy Dwan), a farm girl from Kansas, discovers that she's actually Princess Dorothea, the royal heir to a faraway kingdom called Oz. Suddenly, a powerful tornado whisks Dorothy, her uncle Henry (Frank Alexander) and three farmhands to the magical kingdom. There Dorothy is hailed as the queen of the land by all except authoritarian Prime Minister Kruel (Joseph Swickard), who casts a curse on Dorothy in an attempt to maintain his dictatorial reign. (Fantasy) - 1925

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Stolen Kisses
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The third in a series of films featuring François Truffaut's alter-ego, Antoine Doinel (Jean-Pierre Léaud), the story resumes with Antoine being discharged from military service. His sweetheart Christine's (Claude Jade) father lands Antoine a job as a security guard, which he promptly loses. Stumbling into a position assisting a private detective, Antoine falls for his employers' seductive wife, Fabienne (Delphine Seyrig), and finds that he must choose between the older woman and Christine. (Comedy drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Soft Skin
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While flying to Lisbon, Portugal, to give a lecture, a writer and magazine editor, Pierre Lachenay (Jean Desailly), encounters an attractive flight attendant, Nicole (Françoise Dorléac), and winds up spending the night with her. What was intended to be a one-night stand becomes a tumultuous extramarital affair once he gets back to Paris and his wife (Nelly Benedetti) and kids. Pierre tries to keep the affair secret, but, when his wife suspects him, she snaps. (Romance) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Happiness Ahead
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A bored heiress (Josephine Hutchinson) leaves high society and falls in love with a window washer (Dick Powell). (Musical comedy) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Here Comes Happiness
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A rich girl (Mildred Coles) loves a sandblaster (Edward Norris) instead of the socialite (Richard Ainley) her mother wants her to marry. (Romance) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Princess O'Rourke
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Princess Maria (Olivia de Havilland) and her uncle (Charles Coburn) are in Washington, D.C., where it is hoped she will meet a suitable man to marry. After a number of misfires on the romance front, Maria flies to San Francisco, sedating herself beforehand to combat her fear of flying. Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters. (Romantic comedy) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Wise Girl
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A socialite (Miriam Hopkins) goes Bohemian to save her sister's children from their starving-artist father (Ray Milland) in Greenwich Village. (Comedy) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Traveling Saleslady
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A toothpaste tycoon's daughter (Joan Blondell) sells an inventor's new brand to teach her father a lesson. (Comedy) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: There Goes My Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Eager to break free of her constrained life, heiress Joan Butterfield (Virginia Bruce) runs away from her grandfather's yacht just as reporter Bill Spencer (Fredric March) arrives to get a rare photo of her. Befriended by the kind Peggy (Patsy Kelly), Joan takes an assumed name and moves in with Peggy, then joins her working at Butterfield's department store. Bill, who has begun an article on Joan, visits the store and, recognizing her there, realizes that he has stumbled upon a hot story. (Romance) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Repent at Leisure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A young man falls in love with his boss's daughter. (Comedy drama) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Love and Learn
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A New York socialite (Martha Vickers) plays working girl around two struggling songwriters (Jack Carson, Robert Hutton). (Musical comedy) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Richest Girl in the World
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dorothy Hunter (Miriam Hopkins), the richest girl in the world, has never shown her face to the public. When she arrives in America, Dorothy switches places with her secretary, Sylvia (Fay Wray), to avoid the press. But after Dorothy's fiancé (George Meeker) proclaims his love for another woman, she wonders if any man can love her for more than her money. Still disguised as a secretary, Dorothy falls for Tony (Joel McCrea) and puts him through a series of tests to prove his affections. (Comedy) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bride by Mistake
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has. (Drama) - 1944

moremax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes

moremax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes

moremax.us.title: Contagion

Hostetler thinks his wife, Cathleen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is having an affair and that it may hurt his chances for re-election. However, a bigger scandal than expected pulls in Billy right at the start of his investigation. Double-crossed by the mayor, Billy begins a relentless quest for justice. moremax.us.title: The Art of Getting By
moremax.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Black Butterfly
moremax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

moremax.us.title: They All Laughed
moremax.us.description: The employees of New York City's Odyssey Detective Agency can't seem to prevent themselves from getting over-involved in their clients' lives. His partner, Charles (John Ritter), is similarly unable to keep his hands off the woman he's trailing -- a winsome cheating spouse named Dolores (Dorothy Stratten). (Romantic comedy) - 1981

(Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
moremax.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (Comedy) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: MacGruber
moremax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Sridevi and Yash meet, fall in love and get married. But when Yash discovers he has been granted a medical traineeship in Australia, they are forced to live apart.

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 As Yash leaves India for his medial traineeship in Australia, Sridevi is left at home with his family and the hopes for her future on hold. Four years later, Sridevi arrives in Australia.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Yash takes Sridevi on a surprise date to a waterhole in the Australian wilderness. It is romantic and passionate, but when Sridevi says she wants to start a family, Yash reacts badly.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 With the new resolve to tell no more lies, Sridevi decides it is time to confess her own secret, which threatens to end their already rocky relationship.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 Yash throws himself into work and study as Sridevi finds happiness in a new job and her friendship with Gabs.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E6 Episode 6 Sridevi and Yash finally find joy in their unexpected pregnancy, but just as they move closer to their dream life, their joy starts slipping through their fingers.

sbssydney.au.title: Four Years Later
sbssydney.au.description: S1 E7 Episode 7 With his exam looming, Yash is laser-focused but barely coping. When he doesn't return home after his exam, Sridevi is forced to ask Jamal for help.

wluk.us.title: Full Measure With Sharyl Attkisson

wztv.us.title: Below Deck
wztv.us.description: This reality series profiles a group of young people who work aboard yachts that measure well over 100 feet long. The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Donal's Feasts, Fasts And Festivals
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Donal joins a Muslim family who are fasting during Ramadan, explores the traditions of the Romanian Orthodox Community as he prepares a traditional Easter meal and joins in the atmosphere of Diwali.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Under The Pump Seven weeks after opening, the new Sydney Fish Market faces its first Good Friday as fuel costs, wild weather and an auction failure threaten Easter supplies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Thailand And Malaysia Rick takes a train to Phuket to learn the art of hot and sour tom yum goong, the culinary icon of Thailand. Later he meets up with one of his cooking heroes, David Thompson.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Cuba's Savory Secrets In search of Cuba's most authentic and delicious ingredients, Gordon embraces local ingenuity as he fishes and forages his way across the island.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Ainsley's Taste Of Malta
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Central Ainsley is in central Malta where he starts his day exploring the beautiful ancient city of Mdina. After a tour of the city, Ainsley stops by a restaurant with an impressive history and a great view.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hotel Chocolat At Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Behind the scenes at Hotel Chocolat as they count down to Christmas. With the ambition to design, make and sell over 50 million chocolates this year, it's going to be a busy time for the team.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Black Sesame Tangyuan All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Masters Of Savours
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Salt Nature has given man plants that offer him an infinite number of tastes and sensations. Through passion and patience, he has developed over the centuries the know-how to transform them into exceptional products.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Christmas At The Castle
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Cakes, Trifle And Zombies A Panettone Trifle, a sparkly Lime & Silver Drizzle Cake, and a laugh out loud family game where everyone competes for the Best Christmas Zombie.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Godzilla Minus One
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Japan has barely recovered from World War II when a gigantic peril emerges off the coast of Tokyo. Koichi, a deserter traumatised by his first confrontation with Godzilla, sees this as an opportunity to redeem his conduct during the war.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Girls Will Be Girls
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In a strict boarding school nestled in the Himalayas, teenager Mira discovers desire and romance. However, Mira's mother, who never got to come of age herself, disrupts her rebellious sexual awakening.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Crow's Egg
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Two boys from the Chennai slums constantly make demands on their family who do what they can to provide. A television inspires a shared dream between them, and they start developing schemes to make enough money to buy a pizza.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Lunchbox
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: After her husband's homemade lunch is mistakenly delivered to someone else, a lonely housewife strikes up a friendship via letters with the recipient.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Bend It Like Beckham
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: An Asian teenager cannot tell her traditionally-minded parents that she has joined a women's football team.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Hindi Vindi
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A Sydney teenager bridges cultural gaps through music when he creatively fuses Australian hip-hop with traditional Hindi songs to connect with his beloved grandmother.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Brassed Off
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The threat of a coal mine closure in a small Yorkshire village strikes a sour note with the miners' brass band, who are preparing for a national competition.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Operation Napoleon
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A lawyer is sucked into an international conspiracy after being accused of a murder she didn't commit. Her only chance of survival lies in uncovering the secret of an old German WWII aeroplane discovered on Iceland's largest glacier.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: When Will It Be Again Like It Never Was Before
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Joachim's family home is on the grounds of a psychiatric hospital, where his father is the director. Joachim's unconventional upbringing sees him plagued by fits of anger and sadness.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Becoming Jane
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A youthful Jane Austen meets dashing but poor lawyer Tom Lefroy. The love affair that follows inspires her greatest works.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Explorers
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Three boys combine their talents and construct a homemade spaceship to launch themselves into another galaxy, where they meet some unusual aliens.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Close
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The 13-year-old boys Léo and Rémi have a close friendship at school and in the flower fields where they and their parents pick the harvest for home. When schoolmates shoot a wedge into the relationship, the consequences are fatal.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: The threat of a coal mine closure in a small Yorkshire village strikes a sour note with the miners' brass band, who are preparing for a national competition.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Brief Encounter
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Housewife Laura Jesson meets Dr Alec Harvey at a railway station café and there is a spark. While both are married, they are tempted to adultery before they realise their marriages are more important than the fleeting happiness they may find together.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Tea With Mussolini
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A young Italian boy is taken in by an Englishwoman and her group of eccentric friends in the middle of World War II.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Above Us the Waves
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Based on an actual incident in WWII, this tale follows the efforts of three naval officers to destroy the German battleship Tirpitz, which holds a seemingly impregnable position in a Norwegian fjord.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Arctic Convoy
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In 1941, a convoy carrying vital military supplies to Allied Forces crosses treacherous, enemy-infested waters. The 35 civilian merchant ships brave brutal Arctic seas, fighting for their lives against German air and naval attacks.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Last Samurai
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In the 1870s, a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between Japan's emperor and the samurai.

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Knight of Cups
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Rick is a slave to the Hollywood system. He is addicted to success but simultaneously despairs at the emptiness of his life. A screenwriter living in LA, he tries to make sense of the strange events occurring around him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E1 Castrovalva: Part 1 The Doctor tries to recuperate within the Zero Room, leaving Nyssa, Adric and Tegan to face the Master. Then Adric is taken and the TARDIS plunges towards Event One.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E2 Castrovalva: Part 2 The Zero Room is gone, and the Doctor’s regeneration is unstable. To help him, Tegan locates the tranquil world of Castrovalva and the TARDIS heads there.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E3 Castrovalva: Part 3 Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help the Doctor identify the problem. And the Master is taunting Adric, caught in his web of power.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E4 Castrovalva: Part 4 As recursive occlusion threatens to destroy everything and everyone in Castrovalva, the Master’s space/time trap is revealed, with Adric at its heart.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E5 Four to Doomsday: Part 1 The arrival of the TARDIS is observed by three Urbankans via their manopticon devices. Intrigued, they begin dividing the Doctor’s friends, and disguising themselves as humans.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E22 The Keeper of Traken: Part 2 As Melkur begins to return to life, it manipulates Kassia into doing its bidding. The Doctor and Adric are held responsible for the evil that has come to Traken.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E23 The Keeper of Traken: Part 3 The Keeper nears the end of his life and Melkur is poised to take control of the all powerful source manipulator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E24 The Keeper of Traken: Part 4 Melkur has become the new Keeper of Traken and begins to access the source manipulator. As the Doctor takes steps to defeat it, he discovers the frightening truth about his enemy.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E25 Logopolis: Part 1 Deciding to repair the TARDIS’s chameleon circuit, the Doctor goes to Earth to find a real police box. But an old enemy is one step ahead of him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E26 Logopolis: Part 2 The Doctor travels to the planet Logopolis in the TARDIS where a series of fateful events are set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E27 Logopolis: Part 3 The Master is loose on Logopolis and is determined to learn the planet’s secret, but there is more at stake than he realises.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E28 Logopolis: Part 4 With the fate of the entire universe hanging in the balance, the Doctor and the Master are forced to collaborate and return to Earth to carry out their plan.

BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E9 Kinda: Part 1 While Nyssa rests, Adric and the Doctor discover a military expedition on Deva Loka. Tegan falls asleep in the forest watched by the Kinda, but they cannot stop her dreams.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E10 Kinda: Part 2 Sanders meets Panna and Karuna, who leave a lasting impression on him, while the Dukkha does the same on Tegan. When Hindle’s breakdown begins, the Doctor and Todd are in danger.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E11 Kinda: Part 3 Aris now carries the mark of the Mara and has gained voice, so Panna shows the Doctor and Todd exactly what the past, present and future holds for Deva Loka.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E12 Kinda: Part 4 As the Mara finally breaks free of its dream dimension, the Kinda must do everything they can to contain it. Hindle’s need to destroy everything and everyone is unstoppable.

BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E13 The Visitation: Part 1 The TARDIS lands in 17th century England which is being stalked by a robotic death-like figure from behind a holographic wall. The locals seem to be under a strange mesmeric spell.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E14 The Visitation: Part 2 A Terileptil is living in Sir John's basement and is planning to wipe out mankind with plague rats. It decides to arrange for the Doctor and Richard Mace to be beheaded.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E15 The Visitation: Part 3 Nyssa and Adric and pursued by the Android, and they head to the safety of the TARDIS, while a mesmerised Tegan prepares to unleash the rats on the Doctor and Richard Mace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E16 The Visitation: Part 4 Heading to London Town, the Doctor discovers more Terileptil criminals in hiding. Forced to find a way to stop them, their soliton gas generator explodes, setting London ablaze.

BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E10 Kinda: Part 2 Sanders meets Panna and Karuna, who leave a lasting impression on him, while the Dukkha does the same on Tegan. When Hindle’s breakdown begins, the Doctor and Todd are in danger.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E11 Kinda: Part 3 Aris now carries the mark of the Mara and has gained voice, so Panna shows the Doctor and Todd exactly what the past, present and future holds for Deva Loka.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E12 Kinda: Part 4 As the Mara finally breaks free of its dream dimension, the Kinda must do everything they can to contain it. Hindle’s need to destroy everything and everyone is unstoppable.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E13 The Visitation: Part 1 The TARDIS lands in 17th century England which is being stalked by a robotic death-like figure from behind a holographic wall. The locals seem to be under a strange mesmeric spell.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E14 The Visitation: Part 2 A Terileptil is living in Sir John's basement and is planning to wipe out mankind with plague rats. It decides to arrange for the Doctor and Richard Mace to be beheaded.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E15 The Visitation: Part 3 Nyssa and Adric and pursued by the Android, and they head to the safety of the TARDIS, while a mesmerised Tegan prepares to unleash the rats on the Doctor and Richard Mace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E16 The Visitation: Part 4 Heading to London Town, the Doctor discovers more Terileptil criminals in hiding. Forced to find a way to stop them, their soliton gas generator explodes, setting London ablaze.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E17 Black Orchid: Part 1 A murder is committed in Cranleigh Hall. The Cranleighs ask the Doctor to play cricket and then join them for a masked ball, enabling the killer to hide in plain sight.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E18 Black Orchid: Part 2 The Doctor stands accused, despite Lady Cranleigh knowing he is innocent. What is the secret she is protecting that allows her to let an honest man go to jail.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E19 Earthshock: Part 1 Deadly androids are protecting a bomb buried beneath the Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E20 Earthshock: Part 2 With her crew slowly vanishing, Briggs assumes the Doctor to be the guilty party.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E21 Earthshock: Part 3 The Cybermen are released from their silos and are on the march.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E22 Earthshock: Part 4 The Doctor realises the freighter is now a huge bomb, with one passenger still aboard...

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E23 Time-Flight: Part 1 When a Speedbird Concorde disappears back through a crack in time, the Doctor takes another Concorde to follow its trail, unaware that a mysterious conjuror, Kalid, waits for him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E24 Time-Flight: Part 2 After an encounter with the Plasmatons, Nyssa is possessed by strange aliens while the Doctor, joined by Professor Hayter investigates Kalid’s inner sanctum.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E25 Time-Flight: Part 3 From within their sarcophagus, the gestalt Xeraphin are communicating through Nyssa, but their psychic energy is so powerful, it may destroy her body completely.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E26 Time-Flight: Part 4 The Master’s TARDIS is repaired and the Doctor must follow him back to 20th century Heathrow, once he has rescued all the passengers and crew from both Concordes.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E1 Arc of Infinity: Part 1 On Gallifrey the Doctor has been chosen, during a clandestine meeting, to be used to perpetrate a terrible act. Unaware, the Doctor and Nyssa trace something odd to Amsterdam.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E2 Arc of Infinity: Part 2 Commander Maxil doesn’t believe the Doctor is innocent and reckons the easiest way to stop the evil being reborn on Gallifrey would be to kill him before the bonding can occur.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E3 Arc of Infinity: Part 3 President Borusa thinks the creature has been defeated but within the Matrix, the Doctor unmasks Omega and realises the threat to the matter universe is far from over.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E4 Arc of Infinity: Part 4 Omega has been reborn in Amsterdam in the Doctor's form, but the transference hasn’t worked. The Doctor pursues him through the city, aware Omega is now a walking anti-matter bomb.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E5 Snakedance: Part 1 The Mara is returning home, to the planet Manussa, five hundred years after being exiled. And it is using Tegan's subconscious to get there in the TARDIS.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E6 Snakedance: Part 2 As Tegan tries to rid her mind of the Mara forever, the Doctor learns about the Little Mind’s Eye crystal, while coping with the local politics of the Federator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E7 Snakedance: Part 3 As Tegan and Lon combine to give the Mara access back to reality, the Doctor locates the Great Mind’s Eye crystal but realises it is instrumental in the Mara's plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E8 Snakedance: Part 4 The Doctor and the original snakedancer Dojeen work to rid the planet of the malign Mara once and for all, but it has the whole of Manussa in its psychic grip now.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S20 E9 Mawdryn Undead: Part 1 Caught in a warp ellipse, the TARDIS is drawn to a huge spacecraft orbiting Earth whereupon the Doctor is separated in space and time from Nyssa and Tegan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E2 The Leisure Hive: Part 2 The Tachyon Recreation Generator is the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive. Romana makes repairs, and the Doctor becomes a reluctant guinea pig.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S18 E3 The Leisure Hive: Part 3 The Tachyon Generator has aged the Doctor into a white haired old man, but he discovers the truth behind the machine and uncovers a plot to take control of the Hive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S19 E22 Earthshock: Part 4 The Doctor realises the freighter is now a huge bomb, with one passenger still aboard...

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E36 Police Station Oh, no! George has lost Mr Dinosaur! Maybe the police can help George find him.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E10 Country Kitty To guard a new dinosaur bone, Buddy must learn to pay attention.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E29 The Fruit Festival Santiago and his family team up to save the Fruit Festival when Enrique crashes the party and steals all the fruit!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E42 Romeovision Romeo invents a device that traps the PJM inside TV shows. It's the perfect plan, until he gets trapped inside too.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S379 E4 Lights, Camera, Monsters! Emma and Teo are decorating mechanical monster trucks in the Cubby Cave! Teo pretends to be a robot, and Emma and Teo make a film about a friendly monster called \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E47 Ginger Has Questions Now that Ginger knows his friends are the Peak City Heroes, he wants to know everything about them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E12 Dance Mashup Big Cuz feels way too shy to dance in the school culture concert.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Blackout The plaza is having a blackout! Flower helps Rudy face his fear of the dark, while Flour sees the blackout as the perfect chance to snatch up all the abandoned dinners.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E24 True Blue Swablu May feels a special duty to help a wounded Swablu return to its flock.

Instead, host Sharyl Attkisson -- a veteran journalist who has won multiple Emmy Awards for investigative journalism -- fronts a newsmagazine-style program that features long-form reports from her and a team of correspondents. The investigative pieces cover a range of political and socioeconomic topics that include wasteful spending by the government and corporate fraud. (Newsmagazine) - 2015-10-04

nbcuniverso.us.description: Los hermanos Israel y Andrés están decididos a luchar por un auto. Los novios Edgar y Cinthia regalan una romántica propuesta de matrimonio y buscan el dinero para casarse. (Game Shows, Performing Arts)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Escape perfecto - Celebrando y jugando
nbcuniverso.us.description: Daniel y Olga, esposos por 20 de años, llegan para festejar, ganar muchos premios y multiplicarlos al doble. Manuel y Luis desean duplicar los regalos que logren sacar de la jaula. (Game Shows, Performing Arts)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Casualidad fatal; División desastrosa
nbcuniverso.us.description: La hija menor de Luisa murió con su jefe en un choque, eran amantes y Luisa le exige indemnización a la viuda. Sofía no soporta las peleas entre su padre y su madrastra, quiere desalojarlos. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Abuelos reguetoneros; De tal padre tal hija
nbcuniverso.us.description: La hija de Humberto y María sufre de bullying en la escuela y, para ayudarla, la madre la graba y aprovecha para denunciar públicamente que el padre es gay, haberlo revelado afecta a la pareja. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Divorcio a la italiana; Parto a puñaladas
nbcuniverso.us.description: Yunet y su esposo Alex vivían en Italia, él viajó a Miami, la dejó abandonada con sus hijos y tramitó el divorcio. Junior tenía esposa y dos amantes, una de ellas volvió su vida un horror. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Una semilla de fe
nbcuniverso.us.description: La madre de Marcela se empeña en separar a su hija de Javier, sin considerar el daño que les hace a su nieta y a toda la familia. La niña está a punto de quedarse sin primera comunión, pero no pierde la fe. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Después de la tormenta
nbcuniverso.us.description: Anita trabaja como servicio doméstico y se enamora de Javier, el joven de la casa. Sin embargo, después de un terrible accidente, él se deja seducir por Eloísa, una mujer llena de intenciones ocultas. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Laura, orfandad asistida
nbcuniverso.us.description: Después de que su esposo abusara de su hermana, Laura debe afrontar un difícil divorcio y una injusta batalla por la custodia de su hijo. La desesperación la lleva a actuar de forma impulsiva. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: El final del paraíso - En la boca del lobo
nbcuniverso.us.description: Albeiro y Titi sacan todo su odio acumulado. Por otro lado, el equipo de la Diabla empieza el supuesto operativo para rescatar al niño. (Soaps, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Magda: Una mujer como tantas
nbcuniverso.us.description: Magda y sus hijos se convierten en víctimas de un hombre infiel, obsceno y violento; cuando ella pierde el control, termina presa. Su hija Chela no quiere repetir el mismo patrón de sumisión. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Julia: En mi vida mando yo
nbcuniverso.us.description: Julia, una madre divorciada que quiere enamorarse, se reencuentra con Manuel, un hombre controlador y agresivo. La situación la obliga a denunciarlo, no permitirá que nadie más la maltrate. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Acércate a Rocío
nbcuniverso.us.description: Hablar de los problemas es el primer paso para superarlos y, por eso, Rocío trae un programa único para hablar de las preocupaciones de cada día y, en conjunto, encontrar una solución. (Talk Shows, Lifestyle)
