oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E01 The Texas Seven After seven inmates escape a Texas prison, their crime spree results in the murder of a police officer; a nationwide manhunt leads to six capital murder trials, as one prosecutor must prove how each of the six can be responsible for one murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E02 Deadly Deception The murder of Jamie Faith appears to be a random street shooting until investigators uncover fake identities, thousands of messages and murderous manipulation; prosecutors must prove how a long-distance relationship led to murder in Dallas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Tourniquet Killer When DNA breaks open a decades-old cold case, Kelly Siegler finds herself prosecuting one of the most intelligent killers she has ever faced. What begins with one victim exposes the crimes of a monstrous serial killer who escaped justice for years.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E04 Triangle of Guilt A young woman vanishes after a night out in Dallas, leading investigators to the home of an aspiring rapper in a twisted love triangle; following an international manhunt, prosecutors must prove who killed her with no weapon or cause of death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler ᴺᵉʷ
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E05 High-Heel Homicide A Houston professor is found bludgeoned to death in his high-rise condo. His ex-girlfriend claims she fought for her life with the only weapon within reach: her high-heel shoe. Prosecutors must prove where self-defense ends and murder begins.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays ᴺᵉʷ
oxygenwest.us.description: Sneak Peek: A Season of Suspicion For some, the holidays bring loved ones together. For others, they bring a killer closer to home. Preview the all-new season of Homicide For the Holidays.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E37 Good & Evil After a young woman's body is discovered at a trash facility, a detective promises justice and comes face-to-face with a serial killer; Keith Morrison revisits the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E38 The House A woman finds her father, a former FBI agent, murdered at his house; after digging into his past, police suspect the killer might be close to home; for Josh Mankiewicz, the toxic marriage at the heart of this case makes it unforgettable.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E05 High-Heel Homicide A Houston professor is found bludgeoned to death in his high-rise condo. His ex-girlfriend claims she fought for her life with the only weapon within reach: her high-heel shoe. Prosecutors must prove where self-defense ends and murder begins.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E01 Thanksgiving Terror A woman is shot to death while driving her sons home from a Thanksgiving celebration; the hunt for her killer leads to an unlikely suspect, making investigators realize her murder is not as random as it seems.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E01 The Last Thanksgiving A Thanksgiving feast turns into a family's last when a cold-blooded killer brutally stabs and dismembers a couple the day after their holiday celebration.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E22 Sex, Lies & Murder Part 1 When a woman is found dead in her SUV, the investigation into her murder reveals a tangled web of sex and lies; interviews about the prominent family's dark secrets.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S08 E23 Sex, Lies & Murder Part 2 When a woman is found dead in her SUV, the investigation into her murder reveals a tangled web of sex and lies; interviews about the prominent family's dark secrets.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E12 Toxic Relations When Linda Curry sickens and dies under suspicious circumstances, police and doctors are puzzled, then her close friends and family members speak up.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E01 The Disappearance of Sandi Johnson Sandi Johnson, who always put her kids first, vanishes without a word; police discover dark secrets in Sandi's marriage and several men in her life.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E03 In the Middle of the Night Years after a college student is murdered in her condo, calls to the police lead to the case being reopened and solved.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Affair
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 Like Father, Like Son When police investigate the murder of a Private Investigator the trail leads them to a wealthy woman who had affairs with both a father and his son.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Affair
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 Lost in the Desert When a young military wife goes missing from a Marine base, investigators suspect a forbidden love affair and a secret pregnancy may have driven someone to murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Affair
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E05 His Best Friend's Girl The lifelong friendship of two men is threatened when they both love the same woman, leading investigators to suspect murder when one of them disappears.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Affair
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E06 Dance With the Devil A handsome new dance partner awakens unfamiliar emotions in a conservative young wife putting two marriages in turmoil; when she disappears shortly afterward, investigators must unravel a confusing trail of betrayal and heartbreak to crack the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Relationship With Faith Jenkins
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E05 One-Way Street Jacquelyn Smith is stabbed to death in Baltimore, in what appears to be a random act of violence; as detectives dig deeper, they uncover a diabolical plan, vicious lies and a killer relationship.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Relationship With Faith Jenkins
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E08 Buried Secrets Popular high school senior Chris Daigle mysteriously disappears from Missouri City, Texas; for nearly a decade, his mother will stop at nothing to get answers while keeping friends close but enemies closer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Killer Relationship With Faith Jenkins
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E09 Medical Mystery When Melissa Henderson is found dead in her bed, a perplexing mystery ensues; her husband and family believe her death is from natural causes, but the clues lead investigators to a secret life of spying and jealousy and ultimately to a killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders

kylxld.us.title: Storm of Suspicion
kylxld.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series. (Crime, Reality, Weather) - 2018-10-07

axstv.us.description: Marine Joe Enders (Nicolas Cage) is assigned to protect Ben Yahzee (Adam Beach) -- a Navajo code talker, the Marines' new secret weapon. Enders' orders are to protect his code talker, but if Yahzee should fall into enemy hands, he's to protect the code at all costs. Against the backdrop of the horrific Battle of Saipan, when capture is imminent, Enders is forced to make a decision: if he can't protect his fellow Marine, can he bring himself to kill him to protect the code? bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Fashion Rachel celebrates the quirkiness and individuality of London fashion in her kitchen, proving it's more about creativity than the price tag when it comes to getting your food looking and tasting good.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Crowd Pleasers Rachel makes some simple colorful canapés that are perfect for a party and creates a sophisticated jelly for grown-ups.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Nostalgia London makes Rachel feel nostalgic about her childhood, so she visits an ice-cream lab in North London and makes a firm family favorite - Strudel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Fast Food Rachel explores London's fast food scene, and whips up berry tartlets with cream cheese frosting and cauliflower cheeseburgers.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Lazy Days Rachel prepares her favourite food for the perfect lazy day, cycles along a canal, visits her friend Tom's urban garden, and whips up a shepherdless pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 East Meets West Rachel celebrates London's love with the East as she makes sticky chicken with Malaysian salad and soft steamed buns.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Traditional Values Rachel celebrates Londoners' love of tradition as she puts her own twist on the traditional fry-up and makes a simple one-tray roast.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On The Move Rachel joins an unusual supper club on an old tube carriage and makes sausage and mash for taxi drivers.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 DIY Rachel visits a basement Norwegian style salmon smokehouse and a shop where the shelves are stocked with preserves made on a hob at home.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook: London
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 The Pleasure's All Mine Rachel goes for a decadent champagne afternoon tea in Mayfair and makes some finger-licking ribs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rachel takes a trip to the Bellarine Peninsula, an up-and-coming foodies' paradise, where she meets up with a mussel trawler, winery owner and cheese maker.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Kaplan vs. Green

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Gray vs. Walker

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hall vs. Parker

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Scott vs. McFarthing
divorcecourt.us.description: Clifford says Asia is always searching for things that aren't there; she says she is done with him and the way he uses social media to flirt and cheat.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hightower-Bey vs. Nelson
divorcecourt.us.description: Mali still wants to party, and Zay is ready to settle down; he says if she can't get rid of her clingy ways, he's done.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Martinez vs. Cook
divorcecourt.us.description: Nathaniel says America is always flirting with other men and came home with a hickey one night after she slept with a woman; she is ready to hit the road if he cannot get his anger issues into check.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Garrett vs. Garrett
divorcecourt.us.description: Jacoby says wife Kim has stolen money from the household to feed her gambling addiction; Kim says she is still scratching her head as to why Jacoby's mother badmouths her to everyone.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Garrett vs. Garrett
divorcecourt.us.description: Jacoby is fighting to save his marriage of 15 years; meanwhile, his wife, Kim, has her belongings packed and is waiting for the moving truck.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Harper vs. McCormick
divorcecourt.us.description: Raymond is an Instagram sensation who says his high-school sweetheart is jealous of his social media fan base; Christian accuses him of cheating with his followers; Ray thinks Christian is living a double life.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Mendez vs. Graham
divorcecourt.us.description: Briana and Giovanni suspect each other of cheating; she admits to using a dating app to see if she could find someone with more money.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - McClain vs. Lanier
divorcecourt.us.description: The breaking point came when LaSonya learned that another woman was three weeks pregnant with her husband's baby; he says she would be happier if she had more self-esteem.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ellis vs. Hill
divorcecourt.us.description: Syncere says Mark has lied and disrespected her on several occasions, and she's not going to stand for it anymore; he says he cheats on her because she has a bad attitude, and she gets on his nerves.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Powers vs. Powers
divorcecourt.us.description: Willard says he's tired of his roller coaster ride of a relationship with Cynthia, and he's had as much as he can take with her lies and deception; she says she's doing her best to regain his trust, but he is always reaching back to the past.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Watts vs. Whitsett
divorcecourt.us.description: Dermartess abandoned Rofiesha and their children seven years ago: she has not seen him in seven years and wants a divorce; he says he still loves her and wants to see his children but blames her for his abandoning them.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jacobs vs. Jacobs
divorcecourt.us.description: Clancy asserts that Layaloni is selfish and complains about everything; she professes that he is a good-for-nothing drunk who's always running around with other women behind her back, and he's perpetually broke.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Wright vs. Vance
divorcecourt.us.description: Jeanine says Marvin is cheating with co-workers and often meets up with his exes when they visit family in their hometown; he asserts that she's the one who cheated, she's insecure, and he's sick of her family picking on him.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Chambers vs. Chambers
divorcecourt.us.description: Johnnie says she suspects Henri of infidelity because he acts indifferent and doesn't come home most nights; he says she's a cheater, enables her family members and has developed a gambling habit.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Chambers vs. Chambers
divorcecourt.us.description: Henri and Johnnie's last attempt at rekindling their relationship in Las Vegas ended in disaster as they both were on their own most of the trip.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Schlageter vs. Johnson
divorcecourt.us.description: Kelsey says Justin cheats, doesn't pay bills and is always angry; he argues that she's a liar, and she doesn't help around the house; one of their neighbors called Kelsey and admitted that she had been sleeping with Justin for several months.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Corbitt vs. Patton
divorcecourt.us.description: Stephen says Kisha is crazy and can snap in a split second; she says he is a disrespectful mama's boy.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Cruz vs. Shissiak
divorcecourt.us.description: Billy wants Marylu to quit pole dancing and stripping; he has a fetish for wearing women's underwear, and she wants him to tell her the truth about whether he likes women, men or both.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Pickering vs. Pickering
divorcecourt.us.description: Joseph says his gambling addiction, which is draining the couple's life savings, is Tamika's fault, because she is aloof from the relationship and rarely wants to have sex.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hill vs. Harris
divorcecourt.us.description: Brandon has given baby-mama Sharee a promise ring, but he hasn't promised to do a thing; he wants her to get a full-time job and not work part-time in their business.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Burton vs. Wells
divorcecourt.us.description: Barbara says she's seen Alicia's text messages from men and asserts that Alicia is verbally abusive and financially irresponsible; Alicia says Barbara refused to share her banking information and didn't pay bills, making her feel financially secure.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Wilson vs. Wilson
divorcecourt.us.description: Michaela feels that Richard is a grumpy old man who is always talking down to her; he says he just wants to settle down and enjoy the rest of his life and says that her constant nagging is making him rethink his decision to marry her.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ewing vs. Kyle
divorcecourt.us.description: Anissa and Ma'lik have been together for nine years, and they have endured a lot of heartache due to Ma'lik's cheating and dishonesty; the final straw was when her close friend became pregnant after sleeping with him.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Hamilton vs. Polk
divorcecourt.us.description: Theotis says he is tired of the constant verbal abuse from Tonesha; she says that, because of his constant cheating and non-communication, she is ready to move on with her life.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Fitzgerald vs. Torres
divorcecourt.us.description: Christina and Ramon have been married for two years, and their marriage is plagued with cheating accusations and disrespect; he says he is tired of her enabling his family to the point that he takes refuge in hotel rooms to get a break from her.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Murry vs. McDaniels
divorcecourt.us.description: Lataisha says Chris smokes weed all day and can't keep a job; one day, she walked downstairs in their home and realized that he had moved out; he says she is too aggressive, stalks his social media constantly and is over-demanding for sex.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Cochran vs. Brown
divorcecourt.us.description: Taurean says he talks to other women because Jordan is unaffectionate and verbally abusive to him and doesn't support his dream of being a rap star; Jordan says she would be if he was bringing in rap-star money.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Malleary vs. Pendry
divorcecourt.us.description: Raina creates sexy videos for pay; Ray thinks she is meeting up with her followers and prostituting herself; she says she is supporting him, and he doesn't trust her, constantly checking who she's talking to and where she goes.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Goodwin vs. Goodwin
divorcecourt.us.description: Dashia says William is a cheater who spends most of his money on alcohol instead of paying the bills; he says she is sneaky, belittles him, has trust issues and allows her family to interfere in their relationship.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Davis vs. Blackston
divorcecourt.us.description: Brandi says that fiancée Brittanie is a liar; Brittanie says Brandi is insecure, lacks trust, won't help around the house or pull her own weight, but likes to spend money lavishly.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Chasteen vs. Smallwood
divorcecourt.us.description: After 22 years and three children together, Nichele says Stewart pays the neighbors to spy on her to see if she is cheating on him; he says she's a control freak who likes to tell him what to wear, how to parent and how to clean a house.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Morrison vs. Taylor
divorcecourt.us.description: Roland keeps his relationship with Jeffrey a secret from his family because they disapprove; the couple's violent fights and lack of compatibility in the bedroom are also taking a toll.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Fleurimon vs. Morrison
divorcecourt.us.description: Betty no longer wants to be with David, who is always unemployed and lies about it; David feels like the main reason Betty is mad at him is that she thinks he cheated on her.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Plummer vs. Mims
divorcecourt.us.description: Joel says he and Jerrica would succeed if she would just fall in line in his "kingdom"; she says she can no longer accept his list of rules and take his verbal abuse -- she is ready to walk away.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ard vs. Hyatt
divorcecourt.us.description: Takashia says Brendon doesn't approve of her friends, doesn't trust her and is controlling; he says he can't trust her, because she is a nonstop attention seeker and never passes up an opportunity to flirt with men.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Durham vs. Jenkins
divorcecourt.us.description: Sona can no longer tolerate Milton's cheating ways; he says she is simply insecure and can't let go of the past.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Pettigrew vs. Lovett
divorcecourt.us.description: Sheneka says she was devoted to making her relationship with Rodnie work, but because of his philandering and his inability to help her financially, he's lost her trust, and now she realizes it's time for her to move on.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Santel vs. Uno-Peake
divorcecourt.us.description: Angelina says Mark is too controlling and is more like a father than a boyfriend, always telling her what to eat and when to sleep; he says he's the final decision maker and is tired of her making scenes in public.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Walton vs. Walton
divorcecourt.us.description: DeAndre says Beatrice is lazy and a slob, and he doesn't believe that their two youngest kids are his; she says he is the one who is always cheating and has major anger issues, breaking household items or taking them away when upset.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Oren vs. Griggs
divorcecourt.us.description: Katrina doesn't want anyone else to take care of their daughter; Raleigh says in order to make it in this world you need two incomes, and Katrina's not willing to contribute.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Touchet vs. Cormier
divorcecourt.us.description: Casey is fed up with Quinton's lack of respect for her and their relationship; he says he likes sex, and he enjoys doing his own thing.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Bolton vs. Mitchell
divorcecourt.us.description: A couple with cheating and anger issues were on the verge of splitting up until a pregnancy caused a change of plans.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Burrell vs. McKenzie
divorcecourt.us.description: Amina says that for the last five years, she's paid all the bills and dealt with Christopher's verbal abuse and controlling ways.

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Steele vs. Lawrence
divorcecourt.us.description: Remarcus encouraged Teondra to explore bisexuality, and they've had several threesomes with women, but now he suspects she's having sex without him, and she is not interested in marriage or children.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

classica.us.title: Luisi dirigiert Paganinis Violinkonzert und Brahms
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi ist mit dem Dänischen Radio-Sinfonieorchester aufgetreten. Sie führten Paganinis 1. Violinkonzert und Brahms' dramatisches Sinfonie-Debüt, die 1. Sinfonie, auf. Beide Werke erfreuen sich außerordentlicher Beliebtheit.

classica.us.title: Rachmaninov - Klavierkonzert Nr. 4 und Nielsen 6
classica.us.description: Das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester unter der Leitung von Fabio Luisi spielt Stücke von Rachmaninow und des dänischen Nationalkomponisten Carl Nielsen. Die Solistin des Klavierkonzerts ist die französische Pianistin Lise de la Salle.

classica.us.title: The Unanswered Ives
classica.us.description: Charles Ives ist ein Mann der Dissonanzen - und das in fast allen Bereichen seines Lebens. Seit seiner Kindheit gilt seine Liebe dem Spiel mit der Musik. Doch Charles wurde zu einer Zeit geboren, als man klassische Musiker für Memmen hielt.

classica.us.title: Mozart - Klavierkonzert Nr. 25 & Sinfonie Nr. 35
classica.us.description: Stefano Conticello dirigiert das Orchester des Teatro Comunale di Bologna in einem Konzert. Es wird mit der Ouvertüre aus Mozarts beliebter Oper "Die Zauberflöte" eröffnet. Es folgt das Klavierkonzert Nr. 25 in C-Dur, mit Maurizio Baglini als Solist.

classica.us.title: Schumann - 3. Klaviersonate, Op. 14
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die dritte Klaviersonate, Op. 14 von Robert Schumann.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
classica.us.description: Der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwartz spielt die Davidsbündlertänze Op. 6. Sie sind eine Gruppe von achtzehn Klavierstücken, die im Jahr 1837 komponiert wurden. Sie sind nach Schumanns Musikgesellschaft, den Davidsbündlern, benannt.

classica.us.title: Shusha Renaissance
classica.us.description: Die Stadt Schuscha wird oft als Wiege der aserbaidschanischen Musik und Poesie und als eines der wichtigsten Zentren der aserbaidschanischen Kultur angesehen. Im Januar 2021 wurde sie zur Kulturhauptstadt Aserbaidschans erklärt.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Klavierquintett in Es-Dur, Op. 44
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Grande Dame des Klaviers, Martha Argerich, dem Kammermusikrepertoire in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgenommen wurde.

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen sich Live-Übertragungen von Konzerten im Fernsehen an, beispielsweise das Neujahrskonzert. Die Dokumentation zeigt, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, einem breiten Publikum klassische Musik näherzubringen. - 2012

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. Im Jubiläumsjahr 2021 wurden sie im neu restaurierten Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses mit dem Collegium 1704 aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Barockwerke von Bach, Muffat und Rameau
classica.us.description: Paul Goodwin dirigiert das Conjunto Barroco. Auf dem Programm steht unter anderem Muffats Sonata Nr. 5 in G-Dur. Diese Aufführung wurde am 8. Februar 2024 im Auditorio Sony der Reina Sofía Musikschule in Madrid aufgenommen.

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. - 2019

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 2
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte.

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt.

classica.us.title: Bruckner - 7. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: In einem Konzert von 2019 im Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven leitet Dirigent Hartmut Haenchen das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland. Das Konzert dreht sich ganz um Anton Bruckners 7. Sinfonie.

classica.us.title: Galaxymphony II - Galaxymphony Strikes Back
classica.us.description: Jakob Stegelmann und das DR Sinfonieorchester feiern John Williams und ikonische Filmmusik.

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet.

classica.us.title: Berlioz : Symphonie fantastique, op. 14
classica.us.description: Das Armenische Nationalphilharmonische Orchester führt Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14 auf. Dieses ist unter der Leitung von Dirigent Eduard Topchjan. Komponiert wurde das Stück von Hector Berlioz im Jahr 1830.

classica.us.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
classica.us.description: Die Musikerin Barbara Hannigan gewann den Grammy für das beste klassische Solo-Vokalalbum 2018 und wurde 2022 als Künstlerin des Jahres ausgezeichnet. Im Herbst 2023 gab sie ihr lang erwartetes Dirigentendebüt mit dem Cleveland Orchestra.

hersphere.us.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
hersphere.us.description: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2013-11-21

hersphere.us.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
hersphere.us.description: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2014-11-08

hersphere.us.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
hersphere.us.description: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2015-11-18

hersphere.us.title: The Hunger Games
hersphere.us.description: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2012-03-22

hersphere.us.title: The Glorias

hersphere.us.title: The Iron Lady
hersphere.us.description: In her twilight years, former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher (Meryl Streep) reflects on her life and career as she finally prepares to dispose of the belongings of her late husband, Denis (Jim Broadbent). Daughter of a Grantham grocer, she successfully broke through a double-paned glass ceiling of gender and class. Thatcher became the first female prime minister of the United Kingdom and remained as such for 11 consecutive years, until declining popularity forced her to resign. (Biography, Historical drama, Movie) - 2011-12-30

hersphere.us.title: Big Eyes
hersphere.us.description: In the late 1950s and early '60s, artist Walter Keane achieves unbelievable fame and success with portraits of saucer-eyed waifs. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2015-10-22

moviesphere.us.title: The Legend of Hercules
moviesphere.us.description: As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2014-01-10

moviesphere.us.title: Snowpiercer
moviesphere.us.description: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world. (Action, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Science Fiction) - 2013-08-01

moviesphere.us.title: Conan the Barbarian
moviesphere.us.description: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2011-08-19

moviesphere.us.title: Gods of Egypt
moviesphere.us.description: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2016-02-25

moviesphere.us.title: Sisu
moviesphere.us.description: During the last days of World War II, a solitary prospector crosses paths with Nazis on a scorched-Earth retreat in northern Finland. When the soldiers decide to steal his gold, they quickly discover they just tangled with no ordinary miner. (Action, Movie, War) - 2022-09-09

moviesphere.us.title: Boy Kills World
moviesphere.us.description: Boy is a mayhem machine who's been training to assassinate the bloodthirsty Hilda Van Der Koy and avenge his family's murder; guided by his sister's mischievous spirit, Boy uncovers one stunning revelation after another as he barrels toward Hilda. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2023-09-09

moviesphere.us.title: Crank
moviesphere.us.description: Chev Chelios (Jason Statham), a hit man wanting to go straight, lets his latest target slip away, then he awakes the next morning to a phone call that informs him he has been poisoned and has only an hour to live unless he keeps adrenaline coursing through his body while he searches for an antidote. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2006-09-01

moviesphere.us.title: Crank: High Voltage
moviesphere.us.description: After surviving an incredible plunge to near-certain death, Chev Chelios is abducted by Chinese mobsters. Waking up three months later, Chev finds that his nearly indestructible heart has been replaced with a battery-operated device that requires regular jolts of electricity, or it will fail. Chev escapes from his captors, reunites with his lover, Eve, and sets out on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to get his real heart back. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2009-04-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Watch Your Step
travel.us.description: Russell discovers new sights and sounds deep in the backcountry of Northern California; Bryce talks with a witness who had an experience with a family of Bigfoot; Mireya reaches new heights in search of physical evidence of the elusive creature. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Smells Like Bigfoot
travel.us.description: In NorCal's backcountry, the team develops a clear plan of attack to lure Bigfoot out of hiding; Russell travels overnight, hoping to gather key evidence in their search; Mireya and Bryce conduct an investigation unlike any other. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - The Gathering Storm
travel.us.description: The team's investigations converge as Bryce, Mireya and Russell discover tree structures on different sides of the same mountain; as a storm approaches, Bryce prepares an AI-powered surveillance array that will help pinpoint Bigfoot's location. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Bigfoot's Doorstep
travel.us.description: Bryce, Mireya and Russell converge at the center of their NorCal hot zone as a catastrophic storm threatens the expedition; armed with AI technology, they're ready to meet the elusive cryptid before it's too late; Russell spies signs of Bigfoot. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Why Are They Here?
travel.us.description: Months after the Northern California expedition, Bryce, Mireya, and Russell head to Washington after a fresh lead points to a target zone where Bigfoot groups are congregating for an unknown reason; Survivalist Biko Wright joins the hunt. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Warning Signals
travel.us.description: South of a Bigfoot chokepoint in Washington, Russell follows a trail of warning signs into the backcountry; Mireya and Biko track what could be a curious Bigfoot; Bryce speaks with a witness, who wishes he never laid eyes on the cryptid creature. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Right on Track
travel.us.description: In the heart of The Fork, Russell is on the trail of a possible pair of Bigfoot; Mireya and Biko utilize cutting-edge tech to try and catch a base camp intruder as Bryce makes a startling find while reviewing footage. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Perilous Descent
travel.us.description: Deep in "The Fork," Russell rappels a 700-foot cliff to follow a heat signature; Mireya and Biko track signs outside their base camp; Bryce hears new information about strange vocalizations and discovers that someone has visited his command center. (Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Expedition Bigfoot - Element of Surprise
travel.us.description: Mireya and Biko navigate rapids while tracking a possible hunting party; Bryce gains knowledge from fresh prints; Russell creates a trap for Bigfoot. (Paranormal)

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Fortifications and Cult Practices
truehistory.us.description: Aspects of everyday life in the kingdoms of ancient Israel; how recessed gates are designed to protect cities from enemies; how altars, amulets, painted figures and pottery vessels reflect the religious beliefs at Kuntillet Ajrud and other sites.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - From Jesus to the Creation of the Church
truehistory.us.description: In the early days of the Christian faith, there is no church; no single institution to guide the followers of Jesus; stepping into the world of the early church; the roots of Christianity as found in ancient Jewish traditions and the gospel.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - The First Christian Institutions
truehistory.us.description: In the first century A.D., the followers of Christ evolve from a band of disciples into tight-knit communities of worship; a glimpse of these communities in some of the earliest Christian documents; the Acts of the Apostles and the letters of Paul.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - Christianities in the Early Church
truehistory.us.description: Christianity quickly spreads all over the Mediterranean region in the first few centuries; learning how believers adapt the practice of their faith to create a great diversity of worship in the early church.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - Persecution and Saints
truehistory.us.description: The Christian church catches the attention of the Roman emperor; he views the faithful as a threat to imperial authority and Roman culture; the widespread persecution of Christians that follows; a new class of Christian heroes, the martyred saints.

truehistory.us.title: The Catholic Church: A History - Peace between Empire and Church
truehistory.us.description: In 312 A.D., Christianity gains a powerful ally when the Roman emperor Constantine adopts the faith of Jesus as his own; seeing how this shift affects Christian believers; the church goes from being a persecuted minority to a privileged minority.

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - Biblical Israel - The Story of a People
truehistory.us.description: Entering the world of biblical Israel with a historical overview; an examination of how the Bible gives insights into the daily life of ancient Israelites; considering the context for how the Bible comes into being.

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - By the Rivers of Babylon - Exile
truehistory.us.description: A look at the Babylonian exile; the exiled Judeans begin asking themselves who they are as a people and why they are conquered; as the Bible begins to be compiled in this time of exile, it offers two vantage points for understanding its history.

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - Ancestor Narratives in Genesis
truehistory.us.description: Surveying the stories of ancient Israel's origins as preserved in the Book of Genesis; these origin stories are crucial for understanding the books that follow because ancient Israel understands itself to be a family that descends from Jacob.

truehistory.us.title: The World of Biblical Israel - Moses - The Torah's Central Hero
truehistory.us.description: A look at Moses; the story of the Israelites' exodus from Egypt; tracing the narrative of Moses's journey, which includes receiving the Ten Commandments from Yahweh; reviewing the Torah, the "law of Moses"; the origins of the priesthood.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Land of Canaan
truehistory.us.description: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Arrival of the Israelites
truehistory.us.description: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Jerusalem - An Introduction to the City
truehistory.us.description: Surveying the topography and layout of Jerusalem; reviewing biblical accounts of Jerusalem from the arrival of David around 1,000 B.C.E. to the start of the Babylonian exile in 586 B.C.E.; the remains of an Assyrian siege on the city of Lachish.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - The Jerusalem of David and Solomon
truehistory.us.description: A first look at the biblical City of David; combing through the remains of a scribe's house behind a city wall; the development of biblical Hebrew script; rare examples of this script in a clay sealing, a piece of pottery and a victory stele.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Biblical Jerusalem's Ancient Water Systems
truehistory.us.description: The City of David's ancient water system centered on the Gihon Spring; the three different water systems that are created due to the spring's location outside the city walls; these include Warren's Shaft, Siloam Channel and Hezekiah's Tunnel.

truehistory.us.title: The Holy Land Revealed - Samaria and the Northern Kingdom of Israel
truehistory.us.description: Learning about Israel as it is ruled under the Omride dynasty between Solomon's death and the Assyrian invasion in 722 B.C.E.; exploring ruins such as the High Place at Dan; the acropolis at Samaria, which holds the remains of King Ahab's palace.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S11 E02 Destination Mars Theorists suggest that a voyage to Mars will unlock ancient mysteries about the extraterrestrial origins of the human species while providing the key to its long-term survival.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S12 E08 The Alien Frequency Researchers find that dozens of megalithic sites across the globe were designed to emanate the exact same frequency, causing them to speculate that certain frequencies may allow humans to connect with extraterrestrial forces.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S14 E12 Islands of Fire The native Hawaiians trace their ancestry to beings from the Pleiades star system called the Akua; a look at these islands and if they once had been inhabited by extraterrestrials.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S14 E19 Human Hieroglyphs Tattoos, piercings, and body modification account for a nearly one-billion-dollar industry, but are these practices a bold form of self-expression or could they be motivated by a profound link to ancient ancestors.

unxplainedzone.us.title: Ancient Aliens
unxplainedzone.us.description: S14 E22 Secrets of the Exoplanets Examining some of the thousands of potentially habitable exoplanets discovered over the past 20 years and whether some of them could be home to intelligent extraterrestrial life.

700407.description: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

700407.title: Gardeners' World

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don tackles the perennial problem of what to grow in the shade beneath a tree, Carol Klein takes a look at the crocosmia and we meet a gardener in Derbyshire who has spent a lifetime growing and showing gladioli.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With autumn just around the corner, Adam takes stock of his garden and plans ahead for some late-season interest under the supervision of Ash the cat. Plus, Frances visits a garden in Kent where the plants provide a non-stop buffet for insects.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow this week, Monty reaps a harvest from the vegetable garden, plants up a seasonal pot and gives a masterclass on how to make the perfect compost. Adam Frost travels to York to meet a couple who took on 20 acres of land and filled it with flowers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: The vegetable garden is at its peak now and as well as harvesting, Monty takes a look at how his autumn crops are faring as well as giving tips on how to keep the garden looking at its best. Adam Frost returns to Leicester where he has been helping to create a garden from scratch on a new build estate, and Frances Tophill celebrates the summer harvest on her shared allotment.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond celebrate the horticultural genius of William Robinson in the gardens of his former home, Gravetye Manor in Sussex. Fresh off the back of her success at Hampton Court Palace Garden Festival, Sue Kent gives her own garden some TLC and creates a special container display using small pots. There's also a passionate grower in London who uses every available space in his garden to grow a vast range of vegetables.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse and plans for next year by planting garlic in the vegetable garden. Meanwhile, Carol is home at Glebe Cottage, dividing her perennials to continue the cost-effective stocking of her new beds.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty has tips and ideas for planting up garden pots to provide a focal point over the winter months, Rachel visits the tulips of Keukenhof, Joe visits Esther Rantzen's much-loved garden, and Carol visits Glebe Cottage.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop. Elsewhere, Carol Klein takes first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for a day out in Devon. They are on the hunt for some seasonal inspiration for their new garden and what better place to look than RHS Rosemoor.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As autumn gathers momentum, it's time to start putting the garden to bed for winter. Monty Don has some timely advice on what to do. Carol Klein meets a nurseryman in Herefordshire and together they indulge in the beauty of the Japanese maple.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don prepares the flowering borders for winter and makes a bonfire, Carol celebrates our berry-laden hedgerows, and Rachel visits Julian Clary in his garden.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: At Longmeadow Monty is planting bulbs in pots and around the garden for an explosion of spring colour. Carol Klein travels to Yorkshire where she takes a close look at the enormous colour range and form of a late season perennial, the salvia. Mark Lane is in Oxfordshire looking at how ornamental grasses can be used in planting design to create exciting combinations.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: From giant gooseberries and growing the perfect sweet pea to flamboyant dahlias and plants pollinated by a human hair, this week Monty celebrates the plant passions of some of the extraordinary people featured on the show over the last few years.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. Joe Swift meets fashion icon, Dame Zandra Rhodes, to explore how the flowers she likes to grow have influenced her designs over the years.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty revels in the roses in his garden, harvests honey from his bees and gives advice on the maintenance of hardy geraniums as well as planting others for summer groundcover. Rachel de Thame shows how the most ordinary of spaces can be transformed by adding seasonal containers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area. The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders. Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes. The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: This is the story of the FBI's first capture of an international Lebanese terrorist. In June 1985, the terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian flight #405 shortly before take off in Beirut, Lebanon. On board were American citizens, a professor and his teen son. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force specifically charged with bringing the terrorist to justice in 1989.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors. All agents had to go on was a series of chilling phone calls, a mysterious voice, and the threat of more violence. FBI field offices from New York to Miami coordinated their efforts, determined to catch the vicious killers.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 70s and early 80s, a terrorist group known as the FALN is suspected of setting off bombs in major U.S. cities. Their goal - to bring attention to the Puerto Rican independence movement. As the bombings escalate, innocent lives are lost. FBI agents and police are is in a deadly race to stop this murderous group with a dangerous cause.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power leads to a full-scale mob war. The local Mafia crime family splits in two as the young and the old fight to the death. The FBI is caught in the middle as they infiltrate the syndicate through informants and high-tech surveillance. Agents must find a way to bring down the organization before their civil war leads to innocent causalities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 1980s, the FBI matches wits with a cunning bank robber -- a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history. The robber's planning is meticulous. He executes his crimes with military precision. It will take the combined skills of local police and dozens of agents to catch a criminal mastermind they call, "The Shootist."

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Puerto Rico, violent militants are intent on turning the US Commonwealth into a communist dictatorship. They murder a policeman, turns their guns on a busload of unarmed Navy workers, and even launch an attack on the FBI. These ruthless killers have vowed to fight to the death. The FBI must use every tactic at their disposal to track down the terrorists and bring them to justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1980s, the drug trade ravages Chicago's inner city neighborhoods and violent crime threatens to destroy entire communities. As drug profits grow, gangs rule the streets. One of the most dangerous is the El Rukns. FBI Agents team up with state and local police to bring them down, but in the process, uncover a bizarre and frightening terrorist plot.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Washington D.C, a car bomb takes the life of a former ambassador and his secretary. The FBI is on the case and begins sifting through layers of a wide-ranging conspiracy. The scope of the investigation broadens when it becomes apparent that a foreign government, ruled by a ruthless dictator, ordered the attack. Agents and prosecutors must engage in a political tug-of-war to uncover the identities of the assassins.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1980, extortionists plant a thousand pound bomb in a Nevada casino and demand millions of dollars, or they will detonate the device. The bomb is the largest explosive device the FBI has ever seen. Detonation would be a disaster. Agents and bomb experts must disarm the deadly device, and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In New York, the FBI and local police join forces to battle the constant influx of Colombian cocaine into the city's ports. One detective goes undercover, posing as a Mafia wise-guy, and infiltrates a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel. The detective must be bold, but cautious, taking on the role of a tough-guy, but always aware that if the gang suspects anything, they won't hesitate to kill him.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1980's the New York City Police Department is fighting a losing battle in the war on drugs. Distributors and drug gangs in New York are making millions, and they will do anything to protect their profits. After two law enforcement officers are targeted, hundreds of police officers and FBI agents devise a bold plan to crackdown on the drug gangs and shut down their deadly business.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Puerto Rico, the death of a government witness, and the suspicious circumstances surrounding it, lead the FBI and local authorities to suspect corruption in the highest levels of the police force. With the help of a cooperating witness, investigators find the scope of the corruption is far greater that they first thought. Authorities struggle to capture the rouge officers, men who once swore to uphold the law, but now use their power to commit heinous crimes.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1999, Police investigate two brutal murders in two small towns located hundreds of miles apart. The crimes seem random and unrelated, until investigators discover a terrifying link. Local police and the FBI must untangle a web of liesto stop a dangerous gang that will kill a man for his Identity.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot. The gunman was desperate to stay free, a threat to anyone in his way. The FBI and U.S. marshals teamed up to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1987, Seven inmates break out of a high security prison in New Mexico. The escapees, all violent criminals, are a threat to anyone who crosses their path. State and local police and the FBI know they must capture these men before they rob, rape and kill…again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar -- the gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence. As the robberies grew more violent, agents launched a complex sting: To trap a deadly ring of thieves and shut down their dangerous operation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the winter of 2001, two well-loved and respected college professors are found murdered in their home. Nothing about the case makes sense. No items are missing from the home and the couple had no known enemies. Local police and FBI agents form a task force to find a pair of homegrown killers and a motive for the brutal crime they committed.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorizes the town of East Point. Two people are killed, and two are critically wounded. 400000091.title: The FBI Files

Police and federal agents target the gang, but its leader remains a mystery. In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America, local police, the DEA, U.S. Customs and the FBI work together to take down this dangerous drug gang.

400000091.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
400000091.description: El primero de octubre de 1993, un extraño secuestró a Polly Klaas de doce años durante una piyamada en su casa. El FBI de inmediato entró en el caso. Los agentes reunieron fibras de su habitación y descubrieron, a través del uso de fuentes de luz láser, la huella de una palma en la cama de Polly, previamente invisible al ojo humano. Después de una extensa investigación de dos meses, el FBI arrestó a Richard Allen Davis. La impresión de la palma y las fibras coincidieron y Davis fue condenado por secuestro y asesinato.

724209.description: Ricky Hawthorne, a middle-aged man with a history of AIDS, arrives at his local hospital complaining of chest pains. Doctors perform extensive tests on him but find nothing wrong and release him.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A train passenger behaves oddly en route to Arizona and then disappears. The next day his bloodied body is found in Texas. Dr. G attempts to piece together this bizarre tragedy.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner

673500.title: American Madness
673500.description: During the Depression, the bank owned by generous Dickson (Walter Huston) is barely staying afloat, and things get worse when $100,000 is lifted from the vault. Fingers are pointed at reformed crook Matt (Pat O'Brien), who got a job and a fresh start from Dickson. The innocent Matt can clear his name by admitting that on the night of the robbery he was breaking up a tryst between Dickson's wife and another teller. But this revelation may crush Dickson, and Matt's conscience plays tug-of-war.

673500.title: Divorce American Style
673500.description: A nouveau-riche L.A. couple decide to call it quits after 17 years of marriage, but alimony woes send the bachelor in search of a husband for his ex.

673500.title: The Howards of Virginia
673500.description: When his impoverished past is uncovered, Matt Howard (Cary Grant) is promptly fired by the Peytons, a wealthy family in Williamsburg during the Revolutionary War era. Undeterred, Matt returns to court the family's daughter, Jane (Martha Scott), and the two marry and raise a family in the Virginia backwoods, infuriating the Peytons. The birth of a crippled son results in years of tension between Matt and Jane, and, when Matt decides to join the army, Jane makes a stunning decision.

673500.title: Let's Do It Again!
673500.description: In this 1953 musical remake of The Awful Truth, a recently-divorced couple try every way to make each other jealous.

673500.title: Holiday
673500.description: Johnny (Cary Grant) seems like a solid match for Julia (Doris Nolan), the socialite daughter of Edward Seton (Henry Kolker). Assured that Johnny is a worthy suitor, Edward approves of the pairing. But, as Johnny's wanderlust surfaces -- he is more interested in traveling than in business -- Edward starts to have doubts. Johnny also begins to wonder if he might not be a better match for Linda (Katharine Hepburn), Julia's outspoken younger sister, with whom he has much more in common.

400000088.description: It hurts Dog to see people who after years of walking the straight and narrow, suddenly lose their way. But today's case is a member of the law enforcement community who has recently gone astray, and that truly troubles the Dog.

Meanwhile, Tristan rejoins the group; his friends do not recognize him, since his mind has been downloaded into a mechanical monkey.

itvmeridian.uk.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
itvmeridian.uk.description: Tom Allen celebrates TV chaos with behind-the-scenes cock-ups and broadcast bloopers featuring the nation's favourite TV shows and stars - expect unseen outtakes from TV's finest dramas, comedies and entertainment programmes alongside on-air mishaps from the world of news, daytime TV and sport. Featuring Pedro Pascal, Jeremy Clarkson, Mel Giedroyc, Martin Lewis, Stephen Mulhern, James Martin, Prue Leith and more, the cock-ups include a live football interview being ruined by a rogue sprinkler. (Comedy, Entertainment) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: English Football League Highlights
itvmeridian.uk.description: Action from the day's fixtures across the Football League, including Wrexham v Wolves, Cardiff v Burnley, Watford v Middlesbrough and West Brom v Millwall in the Championship. (Football)

itvmeridian.uk.title: Teleshopping
itvmeridian.uk.description: Shopping from home.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Grantchester
itvmeridian.uk.description: Will and Geordie investigate the death of a circus performer; Will receives a surprising offer that makes him question his life in Grantchester. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2024

itvmeridian.uk.title: Unwind with ITV
itvmeridian.uk.description: A daily delivery of bespoke Mindfulness content designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvmeridian.uk.description: On her morning rounds, Liz takes a moment to appreciate the life the family have built on the farm, but their peaceful routine is interrupted when calf Elizabeth develops a worrying wheeze. Fearing pneumonia, the illness that claimed beloved Cherry last year, Kelvin and Liz call in vet Hugo to investigate. Meanwhile, with the pigs gone, the family begin transforming the old pig field into a vegetable patch. (Documentary, Animals, Outdoors) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - The Hamptons
itvmeridian.uk.description: The East Coast stretch of James' adventure takes him to the Hamptons. Known as being the playground of wealthy New Yorkers, the area has a rich farming history. James taps into this by visiting Amber Waves Farm, where he borrows their outdoor pizza oven to cook for the farmers using seasonal local produce. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvmeridian.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Philadelphia
itvmeridian.uk.description: James visits Philadelphia. `The City of Brotherly Love' is the perfect backdrop for his foodie adventure, with Reading Terminal Market providing all manner of ingredients for both of his cooks. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvmeridian.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itvmeridian.uk.description: On Remembrance weekend, James cooks cured trout and popcorn prawns with ponzu tuna for Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen who talks about his work with the Royal British Legion as well as his career in design and TV. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen.

itvmeridian.uk.title: ITV News
itvmeridian.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvmeridian.uk.description: Joining Alan Titchmarsh at Manor Farm this Remembrance Sunday are racing hero Billy Monger and Gavin and Stacey's Laura Aikman. Plus, a celebration of the role of donkeys during the world wars, and the D-Day Darlings perform a Vera Lynn classic. Then, original emergency service vehicles used to help wounded soldiers during the war years make their way onto the show. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvmeridian.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. (Documentary, Animals, Outdoors) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Talking Royals
itvmeridian.uk.description: A round-up of royal news with expert analysis from ITV News Royal Editor Chris Ship, ITV News royal expert Lizzie Robinson and a host of guests.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itvmeridian.uk.description: Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as four stars - Joey Essex, JB Gill, Caroline Quentin and Harry Akines-Aryeetey - take on each other in the first-ever four-way cooking battle. They'll have to produce stand-out dishes from a recipe they've never seen before in just 30 minutes. The two stars who impress the most go straight through to the quarter-finals, and the losing stars will have to impress the world-class chefs and cook again in the cook-off - where one will leave the competition. (Cookery, Entertainment, Reality) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: ITV News
itvmeridian.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas - Flavour Foundations Bahamian Classics
itvmeridian.uk.description: Ainsley kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp, before wrapping things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw. (Cookery) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Australia
itvmeridian.uk.description: England resume their Nations Championship campaign as they entertain Australia at the Allianz Stadium, Twickenham. After suffering a chastening defeat at the hands of South Africa in Johannesburg in July, Steve Borthwick's side chalked up a comfortable win over Fiji and a slender one over Argentina and now face an improving Australian side. The Wallabies pulled off a sensational 42-38 win over South Africa in Perth back in September. (Rugby)
