nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Where There's a Will, There's a Way; Lost in the Sauce
nick.uk.description: During a heatwave, Will tries to fix the broken air conditioning to protect his family. Ellie's bossy behaviour at Raven Club makes Jack and Lil quit, forcing her to save her friendships and her investigation.

nick.uk.title: Wylde Pak - Follow the Sprinkles; Canyon Valley V Dirk
nick.uk.description: When Lily begins digging to discover why her favourite ice cream van is selling shaved ice, she uncovers a town-wide conspiracy. Dirk is wrongly accused of stealing a Canyon Valley landmark, so Min comes out of retirement as a lawyer to help him.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - My Sister the Weirdo; Turf War
nick.uk.description: Jeanette seeks Alvin's advice when she wants to give a toast to Brittany at her upcoming party. Alvin decides to borrow Brittany's babysitting job.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Mystic Mountain; Candy Confessions
nick.uk.description: Dave worries that the Chipmunks have become addicted to a video game. A grounded Alvin begs Theodore to buy him a limited edition skateboard.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans - No Country for Old Mentors
nick.uk.description: Despite hoping to be matched with her favourite hero in the Superhero Mentor Programme, Phoebe feels pressure to choose her father instead.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans - Date Expectations
nick.uk.description: A desperate Phoebe distracts Max from interfering with her class project by convincing him that a girl at school wants to go out with him. But after Max and his date realise they've been conned, they seek revenge.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Invisible Brad
nick.uk.description: Captain Man's friend Brad, who was accidentally turned invisible years ago, shows up to visit but quickly overstays his welcome.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Spoiler Alert
nick.uk.description: Henry and Ray have to deal with an especially annoying new villain, the Spoiler. Piper is pushed to her limits as she tries to join a popular Captain Man fan club.

nick.uk.title: The Marsupilamis - Mission Park; Mar-Spooky-Lami
nick.uk.description: The Twins and Marsupilamis want to play in the park, but Rosa is guarding the entrance so they need to find another way in. Marcel sneaks into the Chahuta and the Marsupilamis give him a fright!

nick.uk.title: The Marsupilamis - Golfalami / Mar-Sleepwalker
nick.uk.description: The twins and Marsupilamis' game of golf results in Hope and Punch being caught by Stan. The Twins have Callie for a sleepover and whilst sleepwalking she meets the Marsupilamis.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - The Yummyus Pie
nick.uk.description: Chef is worried when the main ingredient for his famous Equinox pie, the Yummyus, is late blooming.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - I'm Off to the Circus!
nick.uk.description: When Clumsy decides to be an acrobat, the Smurfs pretend to be a travelling circus to help him realise his dream. However, an encounter with Gargamel forces them to put on a real show.

nick.uk.title: The Smurfs - I Want a Dragon; Magic Meltdown
nick.uk.description: Tired of not being able to defend himself, Wimpy decides having a dragon would solve his problems. Chef uses a cauldron from Papa Smurf's lab and accidentally brings it to life!

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Tide and Prejudice
nick.uk.description: The Thundermans are visited by High Tide, the former protector of Secret Shores. He decides to take back his old role, even if it puts Jinx and Booch in danger.

nick.uk.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Prank You, Next
nick.uk.description: Max seeks help dealing with a mystery prankster at school from his old principal, who was always the target of his pranks.

nick.uk.title: Henry Danger - Man of the House
nick.uk.description: When Henry's mum has her purse stolen, Captain Man decides he should move in with Henry's family to protect them, but Henry isn't so keen.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - Neighborhood Wash / A Fridge Too Far
nick.uk.description: The Stars' neighbour Gladys is a local vigilante. Patrick, GrandPat and Cecil want Bunny to honour their accomplishments on the fridge.

nick.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show - The Barbarian Next Door; Runaway Patrick
nick.uk.description: After Pat the Hapless moves in next door, Patrick and SpongeBob help him find a job. GrandPat convinces Patrick to run away from home.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Of Mice and Munks; Simon Saves the World
nick.uk.description: The Chipettes fall in love with a mouse that's doomed to be fed to a snake as part of a science class; Simon's new invention threatens to destroy the world.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Gone Gal; Time Traveler's Party
nick.uk.description: After a big fight with Miss Miller, Miss Croner hides out in the chipmunk's treehouse to make Miss Miller worried; Alvin bets Simon that time travelling is possible and hires an actor to pose as one, but a real one shows up.

nick.uk.title: Hey Arnold! The Jungle Movie
nick.uk.description: Arnold and his class win a service trip to San Lorenzo. But when their trip takes a turn for the worst, their only hope of getting home may be retracing the dangerous path that led to Arnold's parents' disappearance.

nick.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - One Trick Sponge
nick.uk.description: SpongeBob learns a new magic trick, but he can't find anyone to watch it.

nick.uk.title: Nickelodeon Slimetime UK - Episode 3
nick.uk.description: The American Football show that serves up everything you need to know about the game with a dash of slime thrown into the mix.

nick.uk.title: Alvinnn!!! and the Chipmunks - Mutiny
nick.uk.description: Desperate to avenge last year's humiliating loss, the Chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory.

nick.uk.title: Sam & Cat - ToddlerClimbing
nick.uk.description: A competing babysitting service is posting fake reviews about Sam and Cat's babysitting service. Sam and Cat confront their competition and discover they're not what they seem to be.

nick.uk.title: Sam & Cat - TextingCompetition
nick.uk.description: Cat discovers Sam is really fast at texting and convinces her to compete in a texting contest against a boy, Butler. Dice tries to avoid an annoying old friend rather than just be honest with the friend.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Biggest Picture in the World
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques - and even a paint cannon. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bigger House
nickjrtoo.uk.description: With a new baby on the way, Mummy and Daddy Pig realise they have run out of space at home! They decide to make their own home bigger with an extension. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Potato's Fruit & Vegetable Quiz
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Potato visits the school to talk about fruit and vegetables. But which team will win his quiz. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rescuing Miss Rabbit!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Baby Names
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is given the very important task of suggesting names for the new baby. She thinks of all sorts of names, but they aren't quite right. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Larenzo Lion
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today, Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Larenzo Lion who lives there! Larenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Martial Arts
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and how to take the right stance. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull Digs Up The River
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They see Mr. Bull, who's using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Doctor Hamster's Big Present
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit that she wants to exercise more, he builds something special to help her. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Police Boat
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig, complete with costumes and a Jolly Roger flag. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Buttercups, Daisies and Dandelions
nickjrtoo.uk.description: During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with wild flowers. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Staying Up Late
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Auntie, Uncle Pig and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late - she even stayed up later than the Daddies. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Coach Peppa
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig's marathon training continues. There isn't long to go before the big day! Peppa takes the role as Daddy's coach and, with George, devises lots of fun games to help. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Patchwork Quilt
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - New Baby
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is so excited to meet her new baby brother or sister, but they are taking forever to arrive until suddenly Mummy Pig announces the baby is coming, now. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Bull The Teacher
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle leaves the class with Mr Bull while she goes to the dentist. But the children already know the subjects Mr Bull suggests teaching. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - TV Land
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Flying Discs
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play Flying Discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Undersea Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Little Swift
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Skate Park
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the Skate Park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Ice Cream
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream - perhaps a little too much. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Strawberries
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig decide to go and pick their own strawberries at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Little Cars
nickjrtoo.uk.description: First, Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars play centre, where Miss Rabbit is in charge. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Shop
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The new club house has a little counter, ideal for playing shop. But what will the children's new club house shop sell. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Igloo
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa's Rock Garden
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children learn about the weather. There is a new friend for Peppa, and Grandpa Pig is making a rock garden. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mandy Mouse's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is Mandy Mouse's birthday, and as a special treat, Mandy is going to Cheese World with her friends. It is the most fun ever. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Roman Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George dress up as Romans, make a pebble mosaic and even learn a little Latin. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Bull in a China Shop
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Accidentally breaking his delicate teapot, Mr Bull takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Not Very Well
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Camping
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family go camping. They put up their tent, collect sticks for a campfire and listen to the beautiful sounds of the great outdoors. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa At The Playground
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Secret Club
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club - going on secret missions, and doing secret things. In secret. But soon everyone wants to join. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Flying Vet
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Doctor Hamster is having a busy day - there are lots of helpless animals that need her help. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's Wooly Hat
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George has a new hat and Mummy Pig is determined that George doesn't get it muddy when visiting Grandpa and Granny Pig. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Power Cut
nickjrtoo.uk.description: One day, the lights suddenly go out and Peppa's house is plunged into darkness. There has been a power cut. Peppa is surprised that even the television won't work without electricity. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr Fox's Shop
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is Granny and Grandpa's anniversary. Peppa and George go to Mr Fox's Shop to find them a present. Mr Fox's Shop sells everything. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bicycles
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig teaches Peppa to ride her bicycle without stabilisers - just like her friends. (Animation, Kids, Children) - 2004

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Muddy Puddles
